name: CJ CGV Co., Ltd.
summary: CJ CGV Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of theaters in South Korea. The company operates The Private Cinema, a private theater; Suite Cinema, a hotel-type theater; Tempur Cinema, a reclining bed theater; Gold Class, a sofa theater; Cine de Chef, a movie theater with a chef; 4DX, a five-sense experience theater; ScreenX, a three-sided extended screen theater; IMAX, a theater that presents image; Cine & Foret, a healing theater with a nature concept; Cine & Living Room, a social theater; and SoundX, a 3D surrounded sound theater. It is also involved in advertising business, special technology, content platforms, and IT services. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
